product_risk_or_requirement: The ward assistant must be mapped against the AI Law and the official high-risk list before it runs on real patients
current_state: Only a preliminary internal reading exists and the published list pages expose an attached file rather than list entries
product_requirement: Block the pilot until counsel maps this exact workflow to the full law text and the high-risk list and records the classification
acceptance_criteria: Given the final pilot scope and the Vietnam market When pilot readiness is reviewed Then a signed classification memo citing the full list text and an AI system inventory record are present
deadline_or_trigger: Before the first patient ward goes live
evidence_needed: Signed classification memo and AI system inventory entry

product_risk_or_requirement: A clinical assistant may fall under the essential-services route or the regulated-product route and the two carry different obligation dates
current_state: The Commission overview confirms tiers and dates but does not resolve which route applies to this workflow
product_requirement: Determine provider and deployer roles and the applicable route before any EU offering and plan evidence to the earlier of the two dates
acceptance_criteria: Given an EU launch candidate When release approval is requested Then a route determination memo role analysis and an obligations plan mapped to the applicable date are signed
deadline_or_trigger: Before offering the assistant in the European Union
evidence_needed: Route determination memo role analysis and dated obligations plan

product_risk_or_requirement: Health records processed by the assistant are personal data and require a lawful basis and an impact assessment
current_state: Data flows are documented but no lawful basis or impact assessment has been signed for the speech and summary pipeline
product_requirement: Establish and record the lawful basis retention limits and vendor data terms for every field the assistant reads or writes
acceptance_criteria: Given the pilot data flow including handover audio When the data protection review runs Then a signed lawful basis record impact assessment and vendor processing terms exist
deadline_or_trigger: Before any patient data reaches the vendor pipeline
evidence_needed: Signed lawful basis record impact assessment and vendor data processing agreement

product_risk_or_requirement: Vendor-reported model performance cannot be assumed to hold on local patients
current_state: The vendor performance claim has not been reproduced on this hospital population
product_requirement: Require local validation of the deterioration score on hospital data with published subgroup results before the flag is shown to clinicians
acceptance_criteria: Given the vendor deterioration score When local validation completes Then measured discrimination sensitivity and alert burden on local data are published to the safety committee and meet the agreed floor
deadline_or_trigger: Before the deterioration flag is visible on any ward
evidence_needed: Local validation report with subgroup breakdown and alert burden figures

product_risk_or_requirement: Transcribed speech can introduce fabricated content into a signed clinical record
current_state: Note drafts are editable but no hallucination control or measurement exists
product_requirement: Prevent unreviewed transcript text from reaching a signed note and measure fabrication rate before widening voice intake
acceptance_criteria: Given a drafted note built from handover audio When a clinician attempts to sign Then unreviewed low-confidence spans block signature and a fabrication rate measurement is on file
deadline_or_trigger: Before voice intake is enabled on a second ward
evidence_needed: Fabrication rate measurement and signature-blocking test evidence

product_risk_or_requirement: A helpline chatbot that reached vulnerable users without clinician oversight shows why the patient-facing non-goal needs enforcement not just a written scope statement
current_state: Access control is designed and the non-goal is written but the negative test is not yet automated
product_requirement: Enforce clinician-only access and automate a regression test proving no patient-facing advice path exists before any pilot ward goes live
acceptance_criteria: Given a non-clinician account When any clinical question is submitted Then the assistant refuses hands off to a human and the attempt is logged for review
deadline_or_trigger: Before the first patient ward goes live
evidence_needed: Access control test report and refusal regression test results

product_risk_or_requirement: Alert fatigue on the deterioration flag can make a nurse dismiss a real alert during a busy shift
current_state: The pilot design proposes one-tap dismissal logging and a weekly review but no per-shift alert cap or live dismissal-rate monitor exists yet
product_requirement: The ward dashboard must cap alerts per nurse per shift require an evidence link on every alert and block widening the pilot whenever dismissal rate crosses the agreed threshold
acceptance_criteria: Given the deterioration flag is live on a pilot ward When a nurse shift dismissal rate crosses 60 percent or alert count crosses 10 per shift Then the dashboard flags the ward for threshold review and blocks adding further wards until thresholds are retuned
deadline_or_trigger: Before the deterioration flag is visible on any ward
evidence_needed: Per-shift alert cap configuration and dismissal-rate monitoring dashboard evidence

product_risk_or_requirement: Voice intake accuracy can differ by speaker group producing a discriminatory record-quality gap for the same care episode
current_state: No subgroup transcription error measurement exists yet and the accessible manual intake path has not been tested
product_requirement: The product must measure transcription error rate by speaker group before voice intake reaches a second ward and offer a tested accessible manual intake path whenever voice capture is refused or flagged low quality
acceptance_criteria: Given voice intake is enabled on a ward When the monthly transcription quality review runs Then subgroup error rates are published and any group gap that persists across two consecutive monthly reviews blocks further rollout until investigated
deadline_or_trigger: Before voice intake is enabled on a second ward
evidence_needed: Subgroup transcription error rate report and manual intake fallback test evidence
